title: Pure Generaider
summary: Pure Generaider control and Rank 9 Xyz build with generic Rank 9s, Links, and staples. Every main-deck Generaider Boss is a Level 9 monster (with a control-only-1 restriction per name) that tributes Generaider monsters or Tokens on either turn to fire off negates, banishes, and board wipes.

summary.title: Starters
points: Loptr, Shadow of the Generaider Bosses tributes a Generaider monster as a Quick Effect during either Main Phase to Special Summon any Level 9 Generaider monster with a different name from the Deck, and boosts all Generaider monsters by 1000 ATK/DEF during the opponent's turn.

Vala, Seidhr of the Generaider Bosses sends another Generaider card from the hand to the GY to Special Summon itself from the hand or GY, then Special Summons another Generaider monster from the hand or GY.
Mardel, Generaider Boss of Light searches any Generaider card or Plant monster (including Generaider Boss Stage or Loptr) when Normal or Special Summoned.

Generaider Boss Quest reveals a Generaider monster in your hand to search up to 2 Generaider Spells and/or Traps with different names from your Deck, then places the revealed monster on the bottom of the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Loptr or Vala + Any Generaider
steps: Normal Summon Loptr, Shadow of the Generaider Bosses and tribute it to Special Summon Mardel, Generaider Boss of Light from the Deck; Mardel searches Generaider Boss Stage (or Vala if you already have Stage).
Send a Generaider from the hand to Special Summon Vala, Seidhr of the Generaider Bosses, reviving Loptr (or another Level 9 Boss) from the GY.
Overlay Mardel and Vala into Rank 9 Laevatein, Generaider Boss of Shadows, and activate Generaider Boss Stage before passing.

When the opponent draws for their turn, Generaider Boss Stage triggers to Special Summon Harr, Generaider Boss of Storms from the Deck in Defense Position, then fills your remaining Monster Zones with Level 4 Generaider Tokens to pay for Harr's omni-negate.

summary.title: Generaider Boss Stage & Token Fuel
summary.text: Generaider Boss Stage is the engine room of the deck: once per turn, when a card is added from the opponent's Main Deck to their hand (including their normal Draw Phase draw), it Special Summons any Generaider monster from your Deck in Defense Position. Then, if you Special Summon a Generaider monster during the opponent's turn, Boss Stage Special Summons as many Generaider Tokens as possible in Attack Position. Those Tokens serve as free Tributes for your Bosses' Quick Effects before vanishing in the End Phase.

summary.title: Bosses & Rank 9 Xyz
points: Laevatein, Generaider Boss of Shadows reduces all opponent monsters by 1000 ATK/DEF and tributes itself as a Quick Effect on either Main Phase to Special Summon Jormungandr, Generaider Boss of Eternity from the Extra Deck, attaching cards from the field and/or GYs up to the materials Laevatein had.

Harr, Generaider Boss of Storms tributes 2 Generaider and/or Spellcaster monsters to negate any card or effect activation, and forces the opponent to send a monster from their hand or field to the GY when they search outside the Draw Phase.
Utgarda, Generaider Boss of Delusion tributes 2 Generaiders to banish a card on the field, while Nidhogg, Generaider Boss of Ice tributes 1 to negate an inherent Special Summon.

Frodi, Generaider Boss of Swords tributes Generaiders to destroy that many monsters, Hela revives a Generaider in Defense Position, Dovelgus deploys Generaiders from the hand, and Naglfar protects your board from destruction.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Generaider Boss Fight activates Generaider Boss Stage directly from your Deck or GY (letting the opponent draw 1 card, which immediately triggers Boss Stage on your turn!).
Generaider Boss Room discards a card when the opponent activates a card or effect in response to your Generaider card/effect, changing the opponent's effect into 'each player draws 1 card'.
Generaider Boss Bite tributes any number of Generaider monsters (such as leftover Tokens) to attach that many different Generaiders from your hand or GY to a Rank 9 Xyz.
